name: AnimBits
summary: Free MIT Framer Motion animation components and hooks via shadcn registry.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 99 registry items (hooks + animation components).
Registry slugs are category-prefixed (e.g. buttons-lift); docs paths are nested (/docs/animations/buttons/lift).

components.name: Lift Button
components.summary: Button that lifts on hover with shadow via useHoverLift.

demo.peerNotes: Free MIT via shadcn registry URL. Framer Motion peer. Copy-paste/registry install; respects prefers-reduced-motion.

components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add https://animbits.dev/r/buttons-lift.json

import { LiftButton } from "@/components/animations/buttons/lift"

<LiftButton />

copyPrompt.text: Use AnimBits free MIT React component `Lift Button` (slug `buttons-lift`) from https://animbits.dev/docs/animations/buttons/lift. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add https://animbits.dev/r/buttons-lift.json`. Import `LiftButton` from `@/components/animations/buttons/lift`. Peer: framer-motion (motion). Home: https://animbits.dev. Docs: https://animbits.dev/docs/installation. Repo: https://github.com/Garvit1000/AnimBits. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Garvit1000/AnimBits/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2025 Gravityy). Pricing free.
